sources.title: D. Levin, Procedures for computing one- and two-dimensional integrals of functions with rapid irregular oscillations
sources.locator: Complete 9-page article inspected. Section 1, equations (1.2)–(1.10), for the first-order equation, collocation construction, and endpoint identity; Section 3, equations (3.6)–(3.9), for error and residual reasoning; appendix inspected for its stated extension and limits.

contents.name: Section 1: oscillatory differential equation and collocation endpoint identity
contents.support: Supports the ODE and collocation construction. The exact endpoint output is checked directly from differentiating p(x)e^{iωg(x)}; no 1/(iω) divisor belongs to the specified ODE.

contents.name: Section 1: residual and coefficient solve interpretation
contents.support: Provides the method context for the locally proved residual-integral and inverse-solve amplification bounds.

contents.name: Section 3: error equations for the collocation method
contents.support: Supports separating continuous residual error from coefficient residual amplification; all claims in this item have a complete local proof.

contents.name: Two-dimensional extension and appendix details outside the one-dimensional scope
contents.reason: The assigned pair proves one-dimensional finite-interval results and does not state or use the paper's two-dimensional extensions.

sources.title: A. Iserles, S. P. Nørsett, and S. Olver, Highly oscillatory quadrature: The story so far
sources.locator: Complete 22-page chapter inspected. §§3.2–3.3 and §4 were read in full; §1 was read for conventions and scope.

contents.name: General oscillatory integral conventions and scope
contents.support: Supplies context for the finite-interval oscillatory integral definition; well-definedness is proved locally.

contents.name: Filon interpolation, polynomial moments, and moment-based quadrature
contents.support: Supports endpoint interpolation combined with oscillatory moments.

contents.name: Fourier polynomial moment recurrence and Filon error behavior
contents.support: Supports exact polynomial Fourier moments; the recurrence proof is local by integration by parts.

contents.name: Endpoint interpolation error for Filon quadrature
contents.support: Supports the method class and second-order frequency behavior; the precise remainder bound is proved locally.

contents.name: Levin operator and collocation construction
contents.support: Supports the operator/collocation method; the endpoint identity is derived locally from the ODE.

contents.name: Levin regularity and collocation error discussion
contents.support: Supports the residual-based analysis context; the theorem's exact bounds are locally proved.

contents.name: Critical points, Fresnel scaling, and stationary phase
contents.support: Supports the local quadratic-phase route, Fresnel normalization, and stationary contribution.

contents.name: Stationary endpoints and coalescing critical points
contents.reason: The single-simple-interior-point theorem explicitly excludes stationary endpoints and coalescence; these require separate endpoint or uniform Airy analysis.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, §2.3 Asymptotic Approximations
sources.locator: Complete §2.3 HTML inspected; relevant subsections (i), (iv), and (v) read in full.

contents.name: Integration by parts for oscillatory integrals
contents.support: Supports the repeated integration-by-parts method; every recurrence and remainder step is proved locally.

contents.name: Stationary phase for a simple critical point
contents.support: Supports the asymptotic form; the local Fresnel tail and remainder estimate are proved in the assigned items.

contents.name: Coalescing critical points and uniform transition behavior
contents.reason: The assigned stationary-phase branch has one fixed simple interior point and makes no uniform claim as critical points coalesce.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, §7.12 Asymptotic Expansions
sources.locator: Complete §7.12 HTML inspected; subsection (ii), Fresnel integrals, read in full.

contents.name: Fresnel integral normalization and oscillatory tail behavior
contents.support: Supports the Fresnel normalization; the assigned proof derives it from the damped complex Gaussian and separately proves ordinary improper convergence.
